releases.title: A better Orbis experience
releases.subtitle: Discover what's new in this release.

items.title: Release Notes Center
items.description: A dedicated release notes experience now renders structured updates with a cleaner, more consistent desktop presentation.

items.title: Improved Update Lifecycle
items.description: The app now keeps a clear distinction between the updater engine and the presentation layer for release notes.

items.title: Version Safety
items.description: Release notes are filtered by the installed app version and only show relevant unseen entries.

items.title: State Handling
items.description: Release acknowledgements are stored centrally and validated safely on startup.

items.title: Changelog Cleanup
items.description: Removed the brittle GitHub-only changelog flow in favor of a structured local release catalog.
